name: application-redaction-highlight
title: Redaction Highlight
description: Text blocks and field rows with toggleable blacked-out redaction spans for sensitive data in reports, documents, and forms.
useWhen: Text blocks and field rows with toggleable blacked-out redaction spans for sensitive data in reports, documents, and forms.
avoidWhen: Avoid redaction highlight when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Redaction Highlight uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
